PRODUCT OVERVIEW

Bumblebee is a compact electric trail motorcycle with a 15 kW permanent-magnet synchronous motor, 72V35Ah battery, aluminium-alloy frame and ECO and Sport riding modes.

PERMANENT-MAGNET MOTOR15 kW maximum power for compact electric trail riding.
ALUMINIUM-ALLOY FRAME71 kg kerb weight with a 120 kg maximum load.
TRAIL SUSPENSION745 mm front and 265 mm rear shock absorbers.
DUAL DISC BRAKESFront and rear disc brakes on 19-inch off-road wheels.

核心亮点

DRIVE SYSTEM

15 kW permanent-magnet synchronous motor in the compact aluminium chassis.

FRONT FORK

745 mm trail-oriented front suspension assembly.

WHEEL ASSEMBLY

19-inch spoked off-road wheel and chain-drive assembly.

BRAKE DISC

Front and rear disc-brake hardware for controlled trail braking.
